title.narrative: Stepping Up Universal Access: A Multi-Sectoral Partnership Response to TB/HIV - Lesotho (01-Jul-2016-30-Jun-2018)

description.narrative: Lesotho, TB/HIV, Ministry of Finance of the Kingdom of Lesotho (MOF)This program has the following goals: To eliminate mother to child transmission of HIV to below 2% by 2018. To reduce new HIV infections and HIV related mortality by 50% by 2018. To reduce TB prevalence by 25% and TB mortality by 50% relative to 2008 rates by 2018. The objectives of this program are: Eliminate mother to child transmission of HIV by 2017/18. Enrol and retain 90% of eligible PLHIV on ART by 2020. To achieve 70% TB case detection while increasing treatment success rate to 90% by 2018. To address key Health System barriers which include governance and leadership at all levels, human resources for health (HRH), procurement and supply management (PSCM), and strategic information management. To increase DST coverage to 95% of prioritized patients (re-treatment cases) and treat all identified MDR TB cases to achieve a treatment success rate of 75% by 2018.. To reduce mortality rate among TB/HIV co-infected patients to less than 5% by 2018

Number of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed TB, new and relapses

Percentage of infants born to HIV-positive women receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Percentage of people living with HIV currently receiving antiretroviral therapy
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of HIV-positive registered TB patients given anti-retroviral therapy during TB treatment

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Number of women and men aged 15+ who received an HIV test and know their results
Percentage of other vulnerable populations that have received an HIV test during the reporting period and know their results
Number of medical male circumcisions performed according to national standards
Percentage of adults and children that initiated ART, with an undetectable viral load at 12 months (<1000 copies/ml)
Percentage of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB started on treatment for MDR-TB who were lost to follow up during the first six months of treatment
Proportion of new individuals who test positive for HIV, enrolled in care (pre-ART or ART) services
Proportion of undernourished PLHIV that received therapeutic or supplementary food at any point during the reporting period
